info.name: GET GeographicLocation based on id and POST a callback request to Digi Call.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the customer. It could be MSISDN, email address, or any other customer identifier. if id is msisdn, format must be E.123

items.docs: This operation finds GeographicLocation based on ID of the user and POST a callback request to Digi Call for the user.
